releaseItems.title: Create a FleetNet customer and verify it via Customer ID search
Add Tax Exemption Certificate field to General step
Support advanced search filters on Customer / Fleet Search
Refine Department management within the FleetNet wizard
inputs/stories/US-MDUI-CUST-001.md
releaseItems.statusText: Ingested from a bolt — not yet reconciled with a real requirements sync

testCases.scenario: Access Customer / Fleet Search
testCases.precondition: User is logged into MDUI with a valid session.
steps: Navigate to Accounts / Fleets.
Click Customer / Fleet Search.
Confirm the Customer / Fleet Search page loads.
testCases.expectedResult: The Customer / Fleet Search heading and search form are visible.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — read-only navigation, no persisted record required.

testCases.scenario: Start FleetNet customer creation from search
testCases.precondition: User is on the Customer / Fleet Search page.
steps: Click Create.
Select FleetNet Customer.
Confirm the General step of the creation wizard loads.
testCases.expectedResult: The wizard opens on the General step with all fields empty.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises navigation only.

testCases.scenario: Verify General step field set
testCases.precondition: User is on the General step of a new FleetNet customer.
steps: Review the General step layout.
Confirm Customer Name, Licensee, System, Division, and Account Product Type fields are present.
testCases.expectedResult: All documented General step fields are visible and correctly labeled.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises layout only.

testCases.scenario: Complete General customer information
testCases.precondition: User is on the General step of a new FleetNet customer.
steps: Enter a valid Customer Name.
Select a Licensee.
Select System and Division for the chosen Licensee.
Select a valid Account Product Type.
Click Next.
testCases.expectedResult: General step validates successfully and the wizard advances to Financial.
testCases.testDataRequirement: 1 Licensee with a valid Division and Account Product Type.

testCases.scenario: Verify Division options populate for the selected Licensee
testCases.precondition: User has selected a Licensee on the General step.
steps: Select a Licensee.
Open the Division dropdown.
Confirm Division options are populated for that Licensee.
testCases.expectedResult: Division options populate correctly for the selected Licensee.
testCases.testDataRequirement: A Licensee with reference-data-configured Division options.

testCases.scenario: Validate missing General mandatory data
testCases.precondition: User is on the General step with mandatory fields empty.
steps: Leave Customer Name, Licensee, and Account Product Type empty.
Click Next.
Confirm each empty mandatory field is outlined in red.
testCases.expectedResult: Save is blocked and every empty mandatory field shows a red-border validation indicator.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises validation only, no persisted record required.

testCases.scenario: Assign Volume Group on General step
testCases.precondition: User has completed required General fields.
steps: Open the Volume Group selector.
Select a valid Volume Group.
Confirm it is saved to the record.
testCases.expectedResult: The selected Volume Group is retained when the step is saved.
testCases.testDataRequirement: 1 existing Volume Group available for assignment.

testCases.scenario: Assign Bill Group and Card Group on General step
testCases.precondition: User has completed required General fields.
steps: Open the Bill Group selector and select a value.
Open the Card Group selector and select a value.
Confirm both are saved to the record.
testCases.expectedResult: The selected Bill Group and Card Group are retained when the step is saved.
testCases.testDataRequirement: 1 existing Bill Group and 1 existing Card Group available for assignment.

testCases.scenario: Complete Financial step pricing
testCases.precondition: User has advanced from General to the Financial step.
steps: Enter a valid Price Reference Code.
Enter a valid Price Reference Amount.
Click Next.
testCases.expectedResult: Financial step validates successfully and the wizard advances to Departments.
testCases.testDataRequirement: A valid Price Reference Code and Amount configured in reference data.

testCases.scenario: Validate missing Financial mandatory data
testCases.precondition: User is on the Financial step with mandatory fields empty.
steps: Leave Price Reference Code empty.
Click Next.
Confirm the field is outlined in red.
testCases.expectedResult: Save is blocked and the empty mandatory field shows a red-border validation indicator.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises validation only.

testCases.scenario: Validate Price Reference Code format
testCases.precondition: User is on the Financial step.
steps: Enter an invalid Price Reference Code (wrong format).
Attempt to proceed.
Confirm a validation message is shown.
testCases.expectedResult: Invalid Price Reference Code formats are rejected with a clear validation message.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises validation only, no persisted record required.

testCases.scenario: Set Customer Lock Status to Locked
testCases.precondition: FleetNet customer exists with Customer Lock Status currently set to Unlocked.
steps: Open the existing FleetNet customer on the General step.
Change Customer Lock Status to Locked.
Confirm Customer Lock Reason becomes a mandatory red-outlined field.
testCases.expectedResult: Customer Lock Reason becomes mandatory as soon as Lock Status is set to Locked.
testCases.testDataRequirement: An existing FleetNet customer with Lock Status currently Unlocked.

testCases.scenario: Verify Departments step empty state
testCases.precondition: User has advanced to the Departments step with no departments yet created.
steps: Advance to the Departments step.
Confirm the empty-state message is shown.
Confirm the Access iFleet To Maintain Departments handoff link is visible.
testCases.expectedResult: Departments step shows a genuine empty state with a working handoff link — behavior for adding a department inline is not fully specified.
testCases.testDataRequirement: A FleetNet customer with no departments configured yet.
testCases.flagNote: Departments may be a read-only grid with an "Access IFleet To Maintain Departments" link, not directly editable fields — needs confirming with the platform team.

testCases.scenario: Verify Access iFleet To Maintain Departments handoff
testCases.precondition: User is on the Departments step empty state.
steps: Click Access iFleet To Maintain Departments.
Confirm the handoff behavior (new tab vs. redirect) matches the spec.
testCases.expectedResult: The handoff to iFleet occurs as documented — exact navigation behavior is ambiguous in source material.
testCases.testDataRequirement: A FleetNet customer with no departments configured yet.
testCases.flagNote: Departments may be a read-only grid with an "Access IFleet To Maintain Departments" link, not directly editable fields — needs confirming with the platform team.

testCases.scenario: Complete Notes step and finish wizard
testCases.precondition: User has completed General, Financial, and Departments steps.
steps: Enter optional notes text.
Click Save/Next.
Confirm the wizard completes successfully.
testCases.expectedResult: The FleetNet customer record is created successfully.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None beyond the record being built through the prior steps.

testCases.scenario: Verify FleetNet customer via Customer ID search
testCases.precondition: A FleetNet customer has just been created.
steps: Navigate to Customer / Fleet Search.
Search by the new Customer ID.
Confirm the record is returned.
testCases.expectedResult: The newly created FleetNet customer is returned by Customer ID search.
testCases.testDataRequirement: The FleetNet customer created earlier in this scenario.

testCases.scenario: Verify optional fields are not incorrectly marked as required
testCases.precondition: User is on the General step.
steps: Review all optional fields on the General step.
Confirm none display a red-border required indicator when empty.
testCases.expectedResult: Optional fields are visually distinguishable from mandatory ones and never show as required.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None — exercises validation only.

testCases.scenario: Verify General Info is displayed at the top of subsequent steps
testCases.precondition: User has advanced past the General step.
steps: Advance to Financial, then Departments, then Notes.
Confirm a summary of the entered General Info is visible at the top of each step.
testCases.expectedResult: General Info summary is displayed consistently across Financial, Departments, and Notes.
testCases.testDataRequirement: None beyond the record being built through the General step.

testCases.scenario: End-to-end FleetNet Customer Create regression
testCases.precondition: No pre-existing FleetNet customer for this test's Customer Name.
steps: Complete General, Financial, Departments, and Notes steps in full.
Save the record.
Verify the record via Customer ID search.
Confirm all General fields, including the new Tax Exemption Certificate field, are present and correctly saved.
testCases.expectedResult: The full FleetNet Customer Create flow completes end-to-end with no regressions, including the newly added field.
testCases.testDataRequirement: A clean environment with no pre-existing FleetNet customer for this test's Customer Name — exactly what Test Data provisioning (Synthetic mode) is for.

testCases.scenario: Verify existing FleetNet customers save successfully when a new General field is blank
testCases.precondition: An existing FleetNet customer created before the newest General field existed.
steps: Open an existing FleetNet customer on the General step.
Confirm the new field is blank and not pre-populated.
Confirm no validation error blocks the page from loading.
Save the record without entering a value for the new field.
Confirm the save succeeds and no regression is introduced for the existing record.
testCases.expectedResult: Existing customers load and save successfully when a newly added General field is blank; no regression is introduced for records created before the field existed.
testCases.testDataRequirement: An existing FleetNet customer created before the current General-step field set (a pre-migration record) — a good fit for Volumizer mode rather than Synthetic.

testResults.errorDetail: Division field returned no options — the selected Licensee ("Acme Distribution") has no dependent divisions populated in this environment.
